anchor: Exactly half the requests are text-only; image-bearing requests carry k×k grids, and the frames class of video-like requests (grids larger than 10×10, only 2.7% of all requests) accounts for 81.2% of all image volume.
claim_text: 50% text-only; frames class (>10x10 grids, 2.7% of requests) accounts for 81.2% of image volume

adjudication.evidence: The three percentages round exactly as claimed (50.0%, 2.7%, and 81.2%), but the universal grid statement fails: 53 image-bearing requests have non-square image counts, meaning they do not carry k×k grids.
adjudication.fix: Soften the universal grid statement from 'image-bearing requests carry k×k grids' to 'almost all image-bearing requests carry k×k grids' or acknowledge the 53 exceptions.
adjudication.query: WITH current_eda AS (SELECT m.* FROM provenance.v_dim d JOIN provenance.eda_metric m ON m.run_id = d.run_id WHERE d.is_current = true), counts AS (SELECT (regexp_match(metric_path, '^context_tokens_by_numimages\.([0-9]+)\.count$'))[1]::bigint AS num_images, value_num::bigint AS requests FROM current_eda WHERE run_id = 'eda:a_quality' AND metric_path ~ '^context_tokens_by_numimages\.[0-9]+\.count$'), picked AS (SELECT max(value_num) FILTER (WHERE metric_path = 'numimages.share_text_only') AS text_only_share, max(CASE WHEN metric_path = 'numimages.all_perfect_squares' THEN value_bool::int END)::boolean AS all_perfect_squares, max(value_num) FILTER (WHERE metric_path = 'classes.frames.request_share') AS frames_request_share, max(value_num) FILTER (WHERE metric_path = 'classes.frames.image_share') AS frames_image_share FROM current_eda) SELECT p.text_only_share, p.all_perfect_squares, p.frames_request_share, p.frames_image_share, sum(c.requests) FILTER (WHERE c.num_images > 0 AND floor(sqrt(c.num_images::numeric))^2 <> c.num_images) AS nonsquare_image_bearing_requests, string_agg(c.num_images || ':' || c.requests, ', ' ORDER BY c.num_images) FILTER (WHERE c.num_images > 0 AND floor(sqrt(c.num_images::numeric))^2 <> c.num_images) AS nonsquare_breakdown FROM picked p CROSS JOIN counts c GROUP BY p.text_only_share, p.all_perfect_squares, p.frames_request_share, p.frames_image_share;

adjudication.observed: fulltrace denominator=1000000; text_only_share=0.5; frames_requests=27183; frames_request_share=0.027183; frames_image_share=0.8119376200533485; all_perfect_squares=false; both superseded_by=null
adjudication.evidence: The current, unsuperseded full-trace metrics support 50%, 2.7%, and 81.2% after rounding, with request and image shares each summing to 1, but explicitly contradict the universal k×k statement because all_perfect_squares=false.
adjudication.fix: Remove the universal clause: "Exactly half the requests are text-only; the frames class of video-like requests (grids larger than 10×10, only 2.7% of all requests) accounts for 81.2% of all image volume."
adjudication.query:
WITH current_eda AS (
  SELECT run_id, window_name, window_requests, superseded_by
  FROM provenance.v_dim
  WHERE is_current = true
    AND run_id IN ('eda:b_marginals', 'eda:j_classes')
), metrics AS (
  SELECT e.run_id,
         MAX(e.value_num) FILTER (WHERE e.metric_path = 'numimages.share_text_only') AS text_only_share,
         BOOL_OR(e.value_bool) FILTER (WHERE e.metric_path = 'numimages.all_perfect_squares') AS all_perfect_squares
  FROM provenance.eda_metric e
  JOIN current_eda d ON d.run_id = e.run_id
  GROUP BY e.run_id
), classes AS (
  SELECT c.run_id,
         SUM(c.requests) AS class_request_denominator,
         SUM(c.request_share) AS request_share_sum,
         SUM(c.image_share) AS image_share_sum,
         MAX(c.requests) FILTER (WHERE c.class_name = 'frames') AS frames_requests,
         MAX(c.request_share) FILTER (WHERE c.class_name = 'frames') AS frames_request_share,
         MAX(c.image_share) FILTER (WHERE c.class_name = 'frames') AS frames_image_share
  FROM provenance.eda_request_class c
  JOIN current_eda d ON d.run_id = c.run_id
  GROUP BY c.run_id
)
SELECT b.window_name AS marginal_window,
       b.window_requests AS marginal_request_denominator,
       b.superseded_by AS marginal_superseded_by,
       m.text_only_share,
       m.all_perfect_squares,
       j.window_name AS class_window,
       j.window_requests AS class_window_request_denominator,
       j.superseded_by AS class_superseded_by,
       c.class_request_denominator,
       c.request_share_sum,
       c.image_share_sum,
       c.frames_requests,
       c.frames_request_share,
       c.frames_image_share
FROM current_eda b
JOIN metrics m ON m.run_id = b.run_id
CROSS JOIN current_eda j
JOIN classes c ON c.run_id = j.run_id
WHERE b.run_id = 'eda:b_marginals'
  AND j.run_id = 'eda:j_classes'
